data.notes: November 2026’s confirmed New Orleans calendar already mixes fall festivals, stadium R&B, and heritage brass/jazz programming, with more club listings likely to fill in closer to the month.

events.title: Beignet Fest 2026
events.venueName: New Orleans City Park Festival Grounds
events.summary: Beignet Fest is confirmed for Saturday, November 7, 2026 at New Orleans City Park Festival Grounds, with local music programming alongside the food festival.

events.title: Hawthorne Heights - 20th Anniversary of If Only You Were Lonely
events.summary: Hawthorne Heights bring the 20th anniversary tour for If Only You Were Lonely to House of Blues New Orleans, with letlive. and Creeper listed on the bill.

events.title: Tremé Creole Gumbo Festival 2026
events.summary: The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Foundation confirms Tremé Creole Gumbo Festival for November 14–15, 2026 at Louis Armstrong Park, with two full days of live music, R&B, funk, brass bands, food, and dance.

events.title: Buena Vista Orchestra
events.summary: Buena Vista Orchestra is listed for House of Blues New Orleans on Monday, November 16, 2026, bringing Cuban son and Latin repertoire to the French Quarter venue.

events.title: Kurt Vile & the Violators
events.summary: Kurt Vile & the Violators are confirmed at The Joy Theater on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, with Twisted Teens listed on the lineup.

events.title: The R&B Tour - Starring Usher Raymond & Chris Brown
events.summary: Usher and Chris Brown bring The R&B Tour to Caesars Superdome for two confirmed nights, Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21, 2026.

events.title: Fruit Bats
events.summary: Tipitina's Presents lists Fruit Bats for Friday, November 20, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM and show at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Nick Shoulders
events.summary: Tipitina's Presents confirms Nick Shoulders for Wednesday, November 4, 2026, with doors at 7:00 PM and show at 8:00 PM.

events.title: 2026 Bayou Classic Battle of the Bands & Greek Show
events.summary: The 2026 Bayou Classic Battle of the Bands & Greek Show is confirmed for Friday, November 27, 2026 at Caesars Superdome, with the Southern University Human Jukebox and Grambling State marching-band tradition anchoring the event.

events.title: PJ Morton: Annual Black Friday Show
events.summary: New Orleans native PJ Morton’s Annual Black Friday Show is confirmed at Orpheum Theater New Orleans on Friday, November 27, 2026 at 8:00 PM.
